import json
import unittest
from event_json import render_event

class EventEncoding(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ascii_escaping_and_default_spacing(self):
        value = {'city': '杭州', 'status': True, 'n': None}
        result = render_event(value)
        self.assertEqual(result, '{"city": "\\u676d\\u5dde", "status": true, "n": null}')
        self.assertTrue(result.isascii())
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result), value)

    def test_controls_and_astral_character(self):
        self.assertEqual(render_event(['🌙', 'a\nb']), '["\\ud83c\\udf19", "a\\nb"]')
        self.assertEqual(render_event({'z': 1, 'a': 2}), '{"z": 1, "a": 2}')

    def test_scalar(self):
        self.assertEqual(render_event(17), '17')
        self.assertEqual(render_event(''), '""')

    def test_other_serialization_defaults(self):
        import math
        self.assertEqual(render_event([math.nan, math.inf, -math.inf]),
                         '[NaN, Infinity, -Infinity]')
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            render_event({('pair',): 1})
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            render_event({1, 2})
        cycle = []
        cycle.append(cycle)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            render_event(cycle)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
